html: להב √ of foll. (cf. Arabic لَهِبَ be thirsty [prob. burn with thirst Lane2674], ii. make a fire blaze fiercely, cf. iv; v. blaze fiercely (of fire), cf. viii; Aramaic [להב, ܠܗܒ] burn, in Shaph. Ishtaph. and deriv.; also לַהֲבָא, לַהֲבוּתָא flame; Ethiopic ለሀበ; Assyrian laʾabu, flame, DlHWB 364).
